title: Chapter 733
text:
After destroying the first altar, they rested for a night in the wilderness before returning to Stone Heart City's gathering point.

After knowing that the operation was so successful, Lan Li was extremely surprised.

"You guys succeeded so quickly?"

He had been leading the Stone Heart City's gathering point for many years and was extremely fearful of the demonic spirit army near the altar. Due to the lack of manpower, he did not dare to take the risk. He thought that Han Xiao and the rest would take at least eight to ten days to slowly clear the demonic spirits on the altar. However, Han Xiao's efficiency had greatly exceeded his expectations.

When he saw that there were no casualties and that only Tomar looked as though he did not sleep well, Lan Li was extremely curious about the details of their operation.

"I remember that there should be hundreds of demonic spirits there. How did you guys do it?"

"It's like this …" Tomar gulped down his saliva and spoke first.

When they were setting up camp last night, Fu Ding had given Tomar a weak spiritual hint. In addition, Han Xiao had asked Aurora to perform a few 'miracles'. Thus, Tomar was completely convinced that Han Xiao and the other three were 'deities'.

Only he knew the truth about the 'deities'. Tomar was so excited that he did not sleep at all last night. In order to fulfill his promise of concealing the identity of the 'deities', he thought hard for an entire night and came up with an excuse. He was waiting to report to Lan Li today.

After explaining everything, Tomar was extremely nervous. He was afraid that Lan Li would notice something wrong.

He did not know why the 'deities' were concealing their identity, but he did not dare to take the risk. He was afraid that if his identity was exposed, the 'deities' would leave. In that case, the gathering point would lose a huge amount of support.

Seeing the fragments of the altar, Lan Li did not suspect anything. After expressing his gratitude to Han Xiao and the rest, he hurriedly left and used his communication magic to report the situation to the other leaders.

"We managed to hide it …" Tomar heaved a sigh of relief.

"You did well." Han Xiao nodded.

Tomar was a little reserved. Although Han Xiao and the other three were amiable and were not as lofty as the deities described in the religious books, he still felt a lot of pressure. He carefully asked, "Your Excellencies, I have a question that I do not know if I should ask."

"Go ahead."

"Actually, I have been curious since yesterday …" Tomar stammered. "Those mythological books said that the gods have their own names and authority. I wonder if you … Cough cough, I don't know if this is an offense, but if it is, I hope that you can accept my apology …"

What he actually wanted to ask was if Han Xiao and the other three were the gods in the myths he had read.

"God's name …"

Han Xiao stroked his chin and smiled faintly. "This is no secret. My god name is Black Star."

Black Star?

Tomar was perplexed. There was no such image in the myths that he knew.

Han Xiao then pointed at Hella and Aurora. "They are the God of Death and the God of Life respectively."

Hella was speechless. In the end, she could only allow Han Xiao to make fun of them.

"As for him …" Han Xiao turned to look at Fu Ding, who had an expectant look on his face. He coughed and joked, "This is the Lucky Prince Charming. By the way, let me remind you that he is an androgynous god with no gender."

Must you emphasize gender? Fu Ding had a helpless expression on his face.

Tomar engraved this in his heart and quickly expressed his loyalty. "I will spread your names and let the world know who the true gods are. I will let your glory spread across this land."

"Let's talk about it in the future."

Han Xiao held back his laughter. When Tomar entered the universe, this might be his dark history.

…

After completing the second round of the mission, it meant that they had obtained the trust of the gathering place. The gathering place placed great importance on Han Xiao and the other three new 'great wizards'. In the following days, they gave them many missions, and they were all part of the mission.

With his overwhelming strength and galactic technology, Han Xiao completed the chain mission with high efficiency. It included destroying the remaining two altars, clearing out the demonic spirits in many towns, killing one of Vosumede's lackeys, collecting rare materials, and so on.

The spaceship could save a lot of time, and the scanning device could easily find rare materials in the entire continent. In just half a month, Han Xiao had solved all the problems that had troubled the gathering place for fifty years.

The entire gathering place was stunned by Han Xiao's miraculous efficiency, and they almost thought that it was a miracle. Tomar had been painstakingly hiding the 'truth' and did not reveal his identity as a 'god'.

However, following that, the upper echelons of the gathering place started to have suspicions. Some felt that the four of them were too successful, and they might be spies sent by Vosumede. They did not care about the losses and put on a show to lure everyone in the gathering place out.

Wulis was the current leader of the gathering place, and he had the most suspicions toward Han Xiao and the other three. However, he did not show it and only kept some secrets from Han Xiao and the others.

His plan was to create a 'divine weapon' that could go against Vosumede. The rare materials that Han Xiao had collected were the materials for the 'divine weapon', and he did not reveal this matter to Han Xiao and the other three.

This way, even if Han Xiao and the other three were spies sent by Vosumede, they would not know his true plan. He even made use of the other party's strength to gather the materials needed to create the 'divine weapon'.

…

In a secret location, all the materials were sent here, and Wulis and a few other upper echelons were secretly creating the 'divine weapon'.

The flames of the furnace lit up the dim room, and a few blacksmiths were forging the prototype of the 'divine weapon'.

Dang, dang, dang!

The hammers continuously struck the iron felt, and sparks flew everywhere. The red-hot metal gradually changed shape.

Wulis and the others continued to sprinkle potions, chant spells, and carve formations to complete the magic process.

Very soon, they reached the final step, and the blacksmiths placed the 'divine weapon' that was about to be completed into cold water.

Chi!

A large amount of water vapor was released, and after a long while, the blacksmiths fished out a twisted metal scepter from the cold water. It looked like a pitch-black vine, and many runes were carved on it.

"It's finally completed! The White Sorcerer Wand! "

Wulis excitedly picked up the wand. This was the 'divine weapon' that the gathering place had always wanted to create. It could greatly increase the power of magic and was extremely effective against demonic spirit armies. It was the perfect counter to the demonic spirit necklace in Vosumede's hands!

All the sorcerers present were overjoyed.

"With the White Sorcerer Wand, we will have the strength to deal with Vosumede head-on!"

Wulis gripped the wand tightly and said, "The existence of the wand must be kept a secret. We must not let Vosumede and the other four great sorcerers know about it. This is our strongest trump card, and we will be relying on it to kill Vosumede. After fifty years, we have finally welcomed the time for the final battle!

"Inform all the sorcerers in the gathering place that it is time to launch our counterattack!"

Wulis' fighting spirit burned fiercely.

…

The chain mission had finally reached the penultimate phase. The requirement was to head to the capital of the Ocean Kingdom and gather with the sorcerers of the other gathering places. The next phase was to face the final boss, Vosumede, in the Ocean Kingdom's royal palace.

In a secret courtyard in the capital, all the sorcerers of the gathering places gathered together. With Wulis as the leader, there were a total of 230 sorcerers.

It was currently evening, and Wulis stood in front of everyone and gave the final speech.

"Tonight is the final battle. We will pass through the guard line of the royal palace and attack the royal palace's Mage Hall. We will gather everyone's strength to kill Vosumede. Vosumede is at his weakest right now, and this is all thanks to the four great sorcerers who have just joined us."

As he spoke, Wulis nodded toward Han Xiao and the other three. His eyes were filled with wariness.

In his opinion, if the four of them were spies, they would definitely be exposed tonight.

Wulis had already made his preparations and secretly ordered his subordinates to keep an eye on Han Xiao and the other three.

Han Xiao smiled and did not reply.

When the final battle was held at night, the mission would reach the final phase, and they would have reaped some benefits.

Tomar mixed in the crowd and clenched his fists in excitement.

Or am I the only one who knows that they are gods?

…

Night fell, and dark clouds covered the city. The sky was dark, and one could not even see one's own fingers.

Seeing that the sky was favorable for the operation, Wulis did not hesitate and announced the start of the operation.

More than two hundred people quietly approached the royal palace and used magic potions to conceal their auras. They did not alarm the guards and quickly headed toward the royal palace's Mage Hall.

Han Xiao and the other three were mixed in the crowd, waiting for the final battle to begin.

Their journey was extremely smooth, and more than two hundred people gathered in the royal palace's Mage Hall.

Wu!

Right at this moment, the sound of the bugle horn could be heard.

The doors of the Royal Court Mage Hall opened, and dozens of Royal Court Mages walked out in a single file. They faced the two hundred Royal Court Mages from afar. In front of the Royal Court Mages stood an eye-catching old man with an arrogant expression. He was Vosumede.

"Hmph, a bunch of rats with rotten teeth. I have been waiting for you guys for a long time."

Vosumede looked at everyone with disdain and said calmly, "I have already discovered what you guys have done in the past half a month, but I could not be bothered with you. Do you guys really think that you can sneak into the capital without anyone noticing? I have been operating in the Ocean Aluin for fifty years, and my demonic spirit army is everywhere. The moment you guys entered the city, I already knew!

Now, the royal palace's guards have already cut off your escape route and are surrounding this place. You guys will not be able to escape! "

As soon as he said that, a commotion broke out among the sorcerers.

Wulis walked out from the crowd and said, "There is no need to panic. The number of royal palace's Mage Hall is less than a quarter of ours. Before the royal palace's guards arrive, we will be able to kill him!"

Vosumede suddenly laughed out loud and said with a mocking tone, "Wulis, is there something wrong with your brain? Have you forgotten what my strongest trump card is?"

As he said that, Vosumede grabbed the silver necklace on his neck. The next moment, the temperature in the area plummeted, and a chilly wind blew. Demonic spirits appeared one after another, and there were at least a thousand of them surrounding everyone.

A huge demonic spirit appeared beside Vosumede. It was the Demonic Spirit King.

The two hundred sorcerers could not help but take a step back and look at the demonic spirit army nervously.

This was the reason why Vosumede had ruled the Magus World for fifty years. His demonic spirit necklace could create and control demonic spirits.

Compared to the others who were panicking, Wulis was extremely confident. He secretly held the White Sorcerer Wand in his hands tightly. This was the nemesis of the demonic spirit army, and it was also the reason why he dared to start a battle.

You have a divine artifact, but so do I. Wulis sneered in his heart.

At this moment, Wulis suddenly thought of Han Xiao's group of four. He narrowed his eyes and dispelled the thought of using the White Sorcerer Wand.

The divine artifact had to be used at the crucial moment, and Wulis was extremely wary of Han Xiao's group of four. He secretly glanced at Han Xiao's group of four and made a decision.

If the four of them are Vosumede's companions and want to do anything, I can use the White Sorcerer Wand to kill them! Wulis thought to himself.

On the other side, Vosumede stroked his beard with a calm expression on his face, as though he had the situation in his hands as he continued with his performance.

"Do you know? Actually, I have never placed you in my eyes. If you had hidden well, I might have been willing to let you live. However, you just had to jump out from time to time to go against me, and you even wanted to kill me. Hehe, your delusions are as unreachable as the stars in the sky, and your existences are as annoying as the flies in the toilet bowl.

A bunch of rotting rats who have been hiding for fifty years, do you really think that you can defeat me? Foolish to the extreme! "

As he said that, Vosumede's luxurious clothes fluttered without any wind, and powerful magic energy fluctuations burst out. In the eyes of Wulis and the other wizards, Vosumede's image seemed to have become a few stories tall, and the pressure from his life form suppressed their souls.

"What is that?" Wulis and the others were startled, and their expressions changed drastically.

"Hehe, there is an even stronger power above the Grand Wizard realm, and I have already used fifty years to take that step …"

Vosumede opened his arms and raised his voice with a proud smile on his face.

"Right now, I am a god!"

The two hundred or so wizards were shocked, and even Wulis's heart skipped a beat.

No, the situation has changed, and I can't keep a trump card to deal with the spy.

I have to use the White Sorcerer Wand to heavily injure Vosumede. Otherwise, the others will suffer heavy casualties!

Wulis could not help but hold onto the White Sorcerer Wand tightly and silently chanted an incantation, preparing to use this' divine artifact '.

Vosumede clearly did not understand that a villain would die from talking too much, and he was still intoxicated by the feeling of having the situation in his hands. He stretched out his finger and pointed at everyone. His gaze was like a giant looking at ants.

"All of you know nothing about true power!"

As soon as he said that, Wulis finished his preparation. His eyes narrowed, and he was about to use the White Sorcerer Wand to deal the strongest blow to Vosumede.

Right at this moment, a psionic cannon shot out from the crowd and struck Vosumede's arrogant face.

It was so fast that he could not even think of dodging.

Bang!

The beam disappeared in an instant, and Vosumede's head disappeared without a trace. Only his charred neck was left.

His headless body swayed a few times before falling to the ground.

“！！！”

At this moment, regardless of whether they were enemies or allies, everyone was stunned.

Everyone stared at Vosumede's headless corpse with shock on their faces. Their brains were unable to process what had happened in front of them.

No one dared to believe their eyes, and they could not help but feel as though they were falling from a high altitude. The difference in their mentality was as though they had jumped off a cliff.

Wait, Vosumede … is dead?

He died just like that?

Wulis' eyes almost popped out of their sockets.

Could it be that I killed him?

That's not right … I haven't used my divine equipment yet …

Everyone thought about the direction where the beam of light came from and turned to look at Han Xiao's group of four. The wizards beside the four of them subconsciously moved aside, revealing the four of them.

"Done." Han Xiao ignored everyone's shocked gazes, put down his hand, and opened the interface with satisfaction.

Just a moment ago, the mission had finally entered the final phase. Without any hesitation, he blasted Vosumede's head off with a single blast. That fellow acted as though he was very powerful, but he was actually just a Grade C Super. With a single blast, there was no need for any fancy tricks.

The wizards present stared at Han Xiao's group of four in a daze, and before they could react, a sudden change occurred.

Hu!

The moment Vosumede died, the demonic spirits lost control and suddenly went berserk. They let out mournful roars and spread out in all directions, pouncing toward all the living beings.

Over two hundred wizards regained their senses and hurriedly prepared to face the enemy.

However, right at this moment, everyone clearly saw Fu Ding, who was beside Han Xiao, pressing his finger on his forehead and releasing a formless white light. The white light swept through the entire battlefield, and the demonic spirits crumbled upon contact.

In the blink of an eye, over a thousand demonic spirits, including the Demonic Spirit King, were annihilated like snow melting under the sun.

This time, everyone saw it clearly, and they froze on the spot with looks of disbelief on their faces.

This … What kind of power is this?

So, Vosumede was really killed by the four of them? Furthermore, it was an instant kill?

Pa!

The light witchcraft wand in his hand fell to the ground, and Wulis' lips trembled with disbelief.

He had made many guesses about what would happen tonight, but he could never have guessed the current situation.

In his opinion, the four of them could be enemy spies, but they actually possessed such terrifying power and killed the leader of the enemy, Vosumede, in an instant.

The White Sorcerer Wand that he had spent so much effort to create was completely useless.

"You guys … Who are you?"

Wulis stared at Han Xiao's group of four, and his eyes were bloodshot as he spoke with difficulty.

His question was also the question that everyone present was shouting in their hearts.

Vosumede had ruled the Magus World for fifty years, but he was actually killed by four unknown Monastics so easily. From the looks of it, it was even easier than stepping on a bug!

This caused the two hundred or so Magi in the gathering hall to feel an incomparable sense of defeat.

Wulis was the one who felt it the most. This scene made him feel that his fifty years of perseverance were completely meaningless.

Han Xiao raised his brows and did not reply. Instead, he turned to look at Tomar.

From the start, Tomar was so excited that he almost peed his pants. From the start to the end, he was the only one who had been staring at the actions of Han Xiao's group of four. At this moment, when he saw Han Xiao looking over, Tomar suddenly understood what was going on.

The next moment, he stepped out from the crowd and spoke loudly, attracting everyone's attention.

"Now that things have come to this, there is no longer anything to hide! I've always known their identities. They are gods, real gods! "

"Only the gods have such power!!"

As soon as he said that, everyone's expression froze, and they were dumbfounded.

God-god-god-god-spirit?!

This answer had exceeded everyone's expectations, and even their thoughts seemed to have stopped.

Everyone present felt as if their worldview had been lifted up by someone and thrown to the ground forcefully, shattering into smithereens.

—
